situations.headline: Horizon Oil: Nam Phong Booster Gas Compressor delivers 84% production uplift, on time and under budget

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Horizon Oil: Nam Phong Booster Gas Compressor delivers 84% production uplift, on time and under budget (interest 6, risk 3)

thesis.text: Horizon Oil's disciplined, low-cost brownfield development strategy is being validated: the Nam Phong BGC, executed quickly post-acquisition and delivered under budget, produced an immediate 84% production uplift under favorable oil-linked gas pricing, supporting near-term cash flow growth from Thai assets and reinforcing management's execution credibility on further low-cost reserve unlocks across the portfolio [asx:d990c626e118a14e5b778dd90bf248a2 p.1].
